units.source_zh: 第三个乃是秀次长女的生母中纳言局阿龟夫人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 第三个乃是秀次长女的生母中纳言局阿龟夫人。她生于摄津小滨的真宗寺院，她不忍看面前女儿的尸首，用念珠遮住眼睛，念起诗来：

paragraphs.source_en: Amida Buddha, reveal your mercy,

units.source_en: Amida Buddha, reveal your mercy,
units.source_zh: > 阿弥陀佛显慈悲，

paragraphs.source_zh: > 阿弥陀佛显慈悲，

paragraphs.source_en: And bear this foolish soul to paradise...

units.source_en: And bear this foolish soul to paradise...
units.source_zh: > 渡我愚顽去极乐……

paragraphs.source_zh: > 渡我愚顽去极乐……

paragraphs.source_en: Next to be beheaded was Lady Kazuko, the mother of Senchiyo. She was the daughter of Hibino Shimotsuke-no-kami, a warrior of Owari, and was only eighteen years old. After Lady Kazuko was executed, the mother of Hyakumaru was also beheaded.

units.source_en: Next to be beheaded was Lady Kazuko, the mother of Senchiyo.
units.source_zh: 次后被处斩的为仙千代的生母和子夫人。

units.source_en: She was the daughter of Hibino Shimotsuke-no-kami, a warrior of Owari, and was only eighteen years old.
units.source_zh: 她乃尾张武士日比野下野守之女，今年仅十八。

units.source_en: After Lady Kazuko was executed, the mother of Hyakumaru was also beheaded.
units.source_zh: 和子夫人被处斩后，百丸的生母也被斩首。

paragraphs.source_zh: 次后被处斩的为仙千代的生母和子夫人。她乃尾张武士日比野下野守之女，今年仅十八。和子夫人被处斩后，百丸的生母也被斩首。

paragraphs.source_en: “The Taikō is terrifying.”

units.source_en: “The Taikō is terrifying.”
units.source_zh: “太阁太可怕了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “太阁太可怕了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “No, those were not His Lordship the Taikō’s orders. It was all the doing of that devil Ishida Jibu.”

units.source_en: “No, those were not His Lordship the Taikō’s orders. It was all the doing of that devil Ishida Jibu.”
units.source_zh: “不，那不是太阁大人的指示，全都是石田治部那个恶鬼的意思。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不，那不是太阁大人的指示，全都是石田治部那个恶鬼的意思。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Alas. Once Hideyori rules the realm, Jibu will be free to do whatever he pleases.”

units.source_en: “Alas.
Once Hideyori rules the realm, Jibu will be free to do whatever he pleases.”
units.source_zh: 一旦秀赖主宰天下，治部就可为所欲为了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “唉。一旦秀赖主宰天下，治部就可为所欲为了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Not only the people of the capital but many warriors as well laid the blame for this tragedy upon Mitsunari. People looked back longingly upon the Hideyoshi of former days. Mitsunari found himself in a most awkward position. In the common people’s eyes, he was an obsequious little opportunist, and his haughty defiance aroused their profound loathing.

units.source_en: Not only the people of the capital but many warriors as well laid the blame for this tragedy upon Mitsunari.
units.source_zh: 不仅是京城百姓，就连武士，也有不少把这次惨剧的责任推到三成身上。

units.source_en: People looked back longingly upon the Hideyoshi of former days.
units.source_zh: 人们都在怀念从前的秀吉。

units.source_en: Mitsunari found himself in a most awkward position.
units.source_zh: 三成的处境变得甚是尴尬。

units.source_en: In the common people’s eyes, he was an obsequious little opportunist, and his haughty defiance aroused their profound loathing.
units.source_zh: 在百姓眼中，他是一个势利小人，其桀骜不驯招致了庶民的巨大反感。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不仅是京城百姓，就连武士，也有不少把这次惨剧的责任推到三成身上。人们都在怀念从前的秀吉。三成的处境变得甚是尴尬。在百姓眼中，他是一个势利小人，其桀骜不驯招致了庶民的巨大反感。

paragraphs.source_en: “You heard them, my lord. Jibu is now condemned by one and all.” After Mitsunari and the other officials overseeing the executions had departed, a warrior who had meticulously recorded the entire proceedings on the riverbank walked beneath the bridge. Tilting up his sedge hat, he addressed another man who had the bearing of a lord.

units.source_en: “You heard them, my lord. Jibu is now condemned by one and all.”
units.source_zh: “您都听见了吧，治部如今是千夫所指。”

units.source_en: After Mitsunari and the other officials overseeing the executions had departed, a warrior who had meticulously recorded the entire proceedings on the riverbank walked beneath the bridge. Tilting up his sedge hat, he addressed another man who had the bearing of a lord.
units.source_zh: 监斩的三成等人离去后，一名在河滩上一丝不苟把整个过程记录下来的武士走到桥下，抬抬头上的斗笠，对另一名主子模样的男子道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “您都听见了吧，治部如今是千夫所指。”监斩的三成等人离去后，一名在河滩上一丝不苟把整个过程记录下来的武士走到桥下，抬抬头上的斗笠，对另一名主子模样的男子道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed. Under the pretext of establishing the Taikō’s authority, he has abused his power.” The man replied and set off toward Teramachi. He was Sakai Tadakatsu, who had come to witness the executions, and the warrior was his retainer Sugihara Chikakiyo.

units.source_en: “Indeed. Under the pretext of establishing the Taikō’s authority, he has abused his power.”
units.source_zh: “是啊，他借为太阁立威的幌子，滥用权势。”

units.source_en: The man replied and set off toward Teramachi. He was Sakai Tadakatsu, who had come to witness the executions, and the warrior was his retainer Sugihara Chikakiyo.
units.source_zh: 男子答了一句，向寺町方向走去——他便是来观刑的酒井忠胜，武士便是家臣杉原亲清。

paragraphs.source_zh: “是啊，他借为太阁立威的幌子，滥用权势。”男子答了一句，向寺町方向走去——他便是来观刑的酒井忠胜，武士便是家臣杉原亲清。

paragraphs.source_en: “Though scheming so carefully to establish his master’s authority may count as loyalty, earning the contempt of thousands for it is hardly worthwhile.”

units.source_en: “Though scheming so carefully to establish his master’s authority may count as loyalty, earning the contempt of thousands for it is hardly worthwhile.”

ja.t: ともいえようが、そのために

units.source_zh: “虽说他处心积虑为主人树立权威，也算忠义之举，可因此遭万人唾骂，实不合算。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “虽说他处心积虑为主人树立权威，也算忠义之举，可因此遭万人唾骂，实不合算。”

paragraphs.source_en: “They simply kicked the bodies into that great pit.”

units.source_en: “They simply kicked the bodies into that great pit.”
units.source_zh: “尸体就那样被踢到大坑里。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “尸体就那样被踢到大坑里。”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is nothing but a grave mound for beasts. It sickens me.”

units.source_en: “It is nothing but a grave mound for beasts. It sickens me.”
units.source_zh: “简直是畜生的坟冢，令人恶心。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “简直是畜生的坟冢，令人恶心。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Our lord ordinarily refuses to kill even an insect.”

units.source_en: “Our lord ordinarily refuses to kill even an insect.”
units.source_zh: “咱们大人平时可连条虫子都不肯杀。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “咱们大人平时可连条虫子都不肯杀。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Enough of that for now. Chikakiyo, whom do you intend to condemn in your account? Heaven, earth, the Taikō, or Jibu, the Lady of Nishinomaru, or young Lord Hideyori?”

units.source_en: “Enough of that for now.
units.source_zh: “先不说这些。

units.source_en: Chikakiyo, whom do you intend to condemn in your account?
units.source_zh: 亲清，你打算撰文责备谁？

units.source_en: Heaven, earth, the Taikō, or Jibu, the Lady of Nishinomaru, or young Lord Hideyori?”
units.source_zh: 天、地、太阁，还是治部、西丸夫人、秀赖公子？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “先不说这些。亲清，你打算撰文责备谁？天、地、太阁，还是治部、西丸夫人、秀赖公子？”

paragraphs.source_en: Chikakiyo clicked his tongue in admiration. “My lord, you truly have a compassionate heart.”

units.source_en: Chikakiyo clicked his tongue in admiration. “My lord, you truly have a compassionate heart.”
units.source_zh: 亲清啧啧道：“大人真是慈悲心肠。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 亲清啧啧道：“大人真是慈悲心肠。”

paragraphs.source_en: “So you still mean to write that Mitsunari is to blame? Of course. If I do not write it that way, the people will never accept it. The people revere the Taikō.”

units.source_en: “So you still mean to write that Mitsunari is to blame?
units.source_zh: “这么说，你还是要写三成？

units.source_en: Of course. If I do not write it that way, the people will never accept it.
units.source_zh: 当然，不这样写，百姓也不会答应。

units.source_en: The people revere the Taikō.”
units.source_zh: 百姓拥戴太阁啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这么说，你还是要写三成？当然，不这样写，百姓也不会答应。百姓拥戴太阁啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yet there are things even the Taikō fails to see. Otherwise, what happened today could never have occurred.”

units.source_en: “Yet there are things even the Taikō fails to see. Otherwise, what happened today could never have occurred.”

ja.t: えぬところがある。そうでなければ、

units.source_zh: “可是太阁也有看不到的地方，否则今日的事也不会发生了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “可是太阁也有看不到的地方，否则今日的事也不会发生了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “That is the heart of the matter: there are always things the human eye cannot see. Advancing age may indeed give rise to such tragedies, but the desire for power is another cause—and the Taikō was blessed with a son only late in life. After this affair, our lord will go up to the capital.”

units.source_en: “That is the heart of the matter: there are always things the human eye cannot see.
units.source_zh: “这才是症结所在，人的眼睛总有看不到的地方。

units.source_en: Advancing age may indeed give rise to such tragedies, but the desire for power is another cause—and the Taikō was blessed with a son only late in life.
units.source_zh: 年龄的增长固然会导致这种悲剧，可对权力的欲望也是原因之一，况且，太阁还是晚年得子。

units.source_en: After this affair, our lord will go up to the capital.”
units.source_zh: 这次事件之后，大人就会进京了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这才是症结所在，人的眼睛总有看不到的地方。年龄的增长固然会导致这种悲剧，可对权力的欲望也是原因之一，况且，太阁还是晚年得子。这次事件之后，大人就会进京了。”

paragraphs.source_en: When Tadakatsu gave Ieyasu a detailed report of what had happened, Ieyasu said not a word. Eager to learn what Ieyasu was thinking, Tadakatsu tried to draw him out: “Both the Taikō and the Kanpaku are deeply unfortunate.”

units.source_en: When Tadakatsu gave Ieyasu a detailed report of what had happened, Ieyasu said not a word.
units.source_zh: 忠胜仔细向家康汇报具体情形时，家康却不发一言。

units.source_en: Eager to learn what Ieyasu was thinking, Tadakatsu tried to draw him out: “Both the Taikō and the Kanpaku are deeply unfortunate.”

ja.t: も、まことにおいたわしいことです。」

units.source_zh: 忠胜很想知道家康的心思，便诱他开口：“太阁和关白都很不幸。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠胜仔细向家康汇报具体情形时，家康却不发一言。忠胜很想知道家康的心思，便诱他开口：“太阁和关白都很不幸。”

paragraphs.source_en: But Ieyasu merely muttered a few vague words, and the following day he went to Fushimi Castle.

units.source_en: But Ieyasu merely muttered a few vague words, and the following day he went to Fushimi Castle.
units.source_zh: 但家康含混地说了几句，第二日，便去了伏见城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但家康含混地说了几句，第二日，便去了伏见城。

paragraphs.source_en: The wedding was held on the seventeenth day of the ninth month. Many of Hideyoshi’s close retainers were displeased, but Hideyoshi himself felt greatly reassured. So long as Ieyasu continued to support him as a kinsman, none of the daimyō would dare rebel... Though the marriage had an element of coercion, Hideyoshi’s calculation had succeeded, and delight spread across his face.

units.source_en: The wedding was held on the seventeenth day of the ninth month.
units.source_zh: 婚礼在九月十七举行。

units.source_en: Many of Hideyoshi’s close retainers were displeased, but Hideyoshi himself felt greatly reassured.
units.source_zh: 秀吉的不少近臣并不为此高兴，可秀吉却备觉安心。

units.source_en: So long as Ieyasu continued to support him as a kinsman, none of the daimyō would dare rebel... Though the marriage had an element of coercion, Hideyoshi’s calculation had succeeded, and delight spread across his face.
units.source_zh: 只要家康一直作为亲戚辅佐他，诸大名就不敢作乱……婚事尽管有强迫的意味，可秀吉的如意算盘还是成功了，他不禁喜上眉梢。

paragraphs.source_zh: 婚礼在九月十七举行。秀吉的不少近臣并不为此高兴，可秀吉却备觉安心。只要家康一直作为亲戚辅佐他，诸大名就不敢作乱……婚事尽管有强迫的意味，可秀吉的如意算盘还是成功了，他不禁喜上眉梢。

paragraphs.source_en: The Taikō had truly grown old. Ieyasu believed that the affair of Hidetsugu was the immediate cause that hastened his decline. In former days, the mere mention of war or battle had filled Hideyoshi with vigor, yet never had a conflict among his own flesh and blood so utterly exhausted him in body and spirit. Early in the eleventh month, Hideyoshi fell ill.

units.source_en: The Taikō had truly grown old. Ieyasu believed that the affair of Hidetsugu was the immediate cause that hastened his decline.
units.source_zh: 太阁真的老了，家康认为，加速其衰老的直接原因乃是秀次之事。

units.source_en: In former days, the mere mention of war or battle had filled Hideyoshi with vigor, yet never had a conflict among his own flesh and blood so utterly exhausted him in body and spirit.

ja.t: てさせたものは、これまで

units.source_zh: 从前的秀吉，一提到作战打仗，立时精神百倍，可是骨肉之间的纷争却从不曾这样让他身心俱疲。

units.source_en: Early in the eleventh month, Hideyoshi fell ill.
units.source_zh: 十一月初，秀吉病倒。

paragraphs.source_zh: 太阁真的老了，家康认为，加速其衰老的直接原因乃是秀次之事。从前的秀吉，一提到作战打仗，立时精神百倍，可是骨肉之间的纷争却从不曾这样让他身心俱疲。十一月初，秀吉病倒。

paragraphs.source_en: At that time in Busan, Konishi Yukinaga and the others were secretly conferring with Shen Weijing, seeking some way to deceive Li Zongcheng, the envoy of the Great Ming, in the vain hope of bringing the peace negotiations to a successful conclusion. Meanwhile, rumors swept through Fushimi Castle that after the Jurakudai was dismantled, the objects removed from it had become haunted by the spirits of Hidetsugu’s wives and concubines. From then on, Hideyoshi spoke nothing but delirious nonsense. He seemed to have lost his senses...

units.source_en: At that time in Busan, Konishi Yukinaga and the others were secretly conferring with Shen Weijing, seeking some way to deceive Li Zongcheng, the envoy of the Great Ming, in the vain hope of bringing the peace negotiations to a successful conclusion.
units.source_zh: 此时，釜山的小西行长等人正与沈惟敬密议，欲寻找一个糊弄大明国使节李宗城的办法，妄使议和成功。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, rumors swept through Fushimi Castle that after the Jurakudai was dismantled, the objects removed from it had become haunted by the spirits of Hidetsugu’s wives and concubines.
units.source_zh: 伏见城里则谣言遍起，说聚乐第被拆之后，运出的器物上附着秀次妻妾的亡灵。

units.source_en: From then on, Hideyoshi spoke nothing but delirious nonsense. He seemed to have lost his senses...
units.source_zh: 秀吉自此胡话连篇，他似神志不清了……

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，釜山的小西行长等人正与沈惟敬密议，欲寻找一个糊弄大明国使节李宗城的办法，妄使议和成功。伏见城里则谣言遍起，说聚乐第被拆之后，运出的器物上附着秀次妻妾的亡灵。秀吉自此胡话连篇，他似神志不清了……
